properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Mixed object: genuine non-CSPRNG usage in production code is kotlin.random.Random / Math.random for job-scheduling jitter (NewLinkedDeviceNotificationJob.kt:44 Random.nextInt(60,180); CheckKeyTransparencyJob.kt:119 Random.nextInt(0,maxHours)) and UI noise — appropriate non-security uses of non-cryptographic randomness, recorded as posture context. Several other sites are SecureRandom calls misgrouped under this label (CSPRNG, see ALG-80605930) or androidTest fixtures (rejected where judged).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-CBC sites combine three uses: legacy v1 storage crypto (MasterCipher AES/CBC/PKCS5 + HMAC-SHA1), attachment stream decryption (AttachmentCipherInputStream AES/CBC/PKCS5 + HMAC-SHA256, MessageDigest.isEqual MAC check), and pinned TLS CBC suites; plus an internal debug playground site. All real CBC usage; MAC-protected in the data paths.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA1 appears in two roles: (1) RFC 6238 TOTP for account registration (HmacSHA1 is the RFC default) and (2) the legacy v1 master-secret encrypt-then-MAC (MasterCipher/MasterSecret/AsymmetricMasterCipher/MasterSecretUtil) — legacy but real. PQ-safe primitive (symmetric MAC); 160-bit tag halves to 80-bit effective under Grover, still adequate for these uses.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CTR/CFB/OFB sites: legacy backup streams (AES/CTR + HMAC-SHA256 encrypt-then-MAC), Glide cache encryption (AES/CTR unauthenticated — derived cache data, low sensitivity), and the v2 archiver's Aes256Ctr32. CTR without MAC exists only in the disk-cache coder.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Constant-time comparison posture: MessageDigest.isEqual used for MAC and digest comparisons in the crypto paths (BackupRecordInputStream, ApkUpdateInstaller, AttachmentCipherInputStream MAC check) — correct posture control, app-controlled.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SignalServiceNetworkAccess pins three TLS 1.2 ConnectionSpecs (GMAPS/GMAIL/PLAY reflector hosts, used for censorship-circumvention domain fronting) built from MODERN_TLS but re-enabling ECDHE_ECDSA/ECDHE_RSA suites (and static TLS_RSA_* suites at lines 99-102/116-118/132-134). All 22 sites of this object are the ECDHE key-exchange half of those suite lists. The app's own Signal endpoints use APP_CONNECTION_SPEC = ConnectionSpec.MODERN_TLS (line 139), which on modern OkHttp/Android includes TLS 1

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Legacy (v1) passphrase master-secret system: durable Curve25519 keypairs stored under these preference keys, used by AsymmetricMasterCipher — ephemeral Curve25519 ECDH (X25519) against the local public key, KDF, then AES-CBC + HMAC-SHA1 — to encrypt the master secret until the user enters their passphrase. Sites are storage identifiers and the AccountValues migration reads of "pref_identity_public_curve25519" (legacy identity keys). X25519 ECDH is Shor-vulnerable; this is local, user-controlled

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA256/SHA384 are the modern MAC layer: backup frame authentication (encrypt-then-MAC over AES-CTR), attachment stream MACs, sealed-sender access keys, key-transparency commitments. PQ-safe symmetric MACs (Grover → 128-bit effective).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-GCM fills four roles in this codebase: (1) Signal's own JNI AES-GCM JCA provider (org.signal:aesgcmprovider 0.0.4) installed as Security provider #1 at app startup (ApplicationContext.java:360) — direct mitigation of AndroidOpenSSL GCM performance/IV problems; (2) KeyStoreHelper (core/util): a hardware-backed AndroidKeyStore AES-GCM key generated via KeyGenParameterSpec (BLOCK_MODE_GCM, ENCRYPTION_PADDING_NONE, PURPOSE_ENCRYPT|DECRYPT) that seals/unseals the app database secret through Ciphe

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 digests used across integrity paths: attachment plaintext/incremental digests (AttachmentCipherInputStream), APK update digest checks, backup verification — PQ-safe (Grover halves to 128-bit effective).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 sites are the 128-bit-halves of the pinned reflector TLS suites in SignalServiceNetworkAccess.kt (GMAPS/GMAIL/PLAY specs) plus the ScrubberTest log vector (rejected). Live TLS cipher-suite pinning; bulk-cipher strength is secondary to the KEX dimension tracked separately.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HKDF sites: backup key derivation ("Backup Export" → AES-CTR + HMAC-SHA256 pair), GV2 migration master-key derivation, demo module mirror. PQ-safe KDF used with domain-separation info strings.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 sites: the v2 local backup archiver (Aes256Ctr32 — real on-device AES-256-CTR) and the AES-256 TLS suite pins (GMAPS/GMAIL/PLAY). PQ-safe bulk cipher; TLS suite sites carry the ECDHE/static-RSA key-exchange context.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SecureRandom is the app's randomness source for all security purposes: prekey IDs, attachment/backup IVs and keys, sticker/avatar IDs, keystore-adjacent nonces. No java.util.Random/Math.random feeding crypto paths was found (non-CSPRNG uses are jitter/UI, see ALG-7d1fdc12). PQ-safe.
